notes.title: Game release
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

The game is now released after being worked on occasionally as a hobby for a long time.
It's a heavily story focused game about Squalus, a mage that got captured by bandits and sold as a slave to a noble's daughter. Explore the mansion and avoid being used by the mistress, or surrender to her in this short, erotic adventure.

Feel free to connect with us on our discord server, or check out our publishing page on steam to see what else we working on!

And most importantly, enjoy your stay in Frostacre!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Dorei Same followers![/h1]

Still been busy with other jobs and projects. But over the course of a long time, I have made good progress on this too and it is not far from completion. It needs a bit more work on story/game events, testing and bugfixing, and implementation of the remaining erotic scene.

It may still take a while, but I hope to have this done during this summer. No later than that.

[h1]What to do moving forward[/h1]

- Testing and bug fixing
- Implement last erotic scene

As usual, you can stay updated on my [url=https://discord.gg/veB6fjPycS ]server[/url]

Happy summer!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Dorei Same followers![/h1]
I haven't posted any updates, which honestly is bad of me. But, better late than never.

Dorei Same is a story about Squalus being sold as a slave to a wealthy daughter. One wants to explore her sexuality in secret while the other is confused about what she wants in life at all. The story of the game explores this connection between the two.

I have been focusing on building their characters and relationship lately. In terms of gameplay, there will be some moments of control, choices and exploration, but the game is heavily story-orientated. It features some spicy scenes with probably at least one more to come.

I have admittedly been focused on a different project a lot lately, but I do take days to work on Dorei Same now and then. Still, it should hopefully not take too long before release since the game is not meant to be very long.

[h1]What to do moving forward[/h1]

- Keep working on the different story events
- Implement more art and spicy scene(s)
- Fix potential glitches
